title: Plan Sync picker lists keep scroll position
description:
Choosing a PSR jobsite or PDF plan in Plan Sync was rebuilding the whole modal, which jumped every list back to the top. Scroll position is now preserved across those updates (and while searching), so you can keep picking without losing your place.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan Sync on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map36). Open Plan Sync, scroll a list, click/right-click rows — the list should stay put.
changeLog: Preserve Plan Sync list scroll when adding/removing PSR or PDF rows.
Preserve scroll while typing in the Plan Sync search box.
Mark rows already in the group builder; click or right-click to add.
